newest.title: Jay Clayton Leads New Federal AI Task Force: What Changes for Contractors
newest.description: Jay Clayton Leads New Federal AI Task Force: What Changes for Contractors. The White House has just centralized AI policy under a new federal task force, while major AI labs are suddenly backing mandatory reporting laws. We’re breaking down what this means for your security and the companies you work with. What we covered: • Trump names Jay Clayton to lead a new federal AI task force • OpenAI and Anthropic tell Australia they would welcome mandatory reporting of AI agent hacks • AI insiders warn New York City leaders as local governments take up safety concerns Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways. Listener question: If your city required AI companies to testify under oath about safety, would you trust the results more than federal oversight? What to watch tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules. Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next. What changed. Who wins. What you do next. Follow The AI Edge on Spotify for a new AI news and analysis episode every weekday.
